title: FEEL. | Complete Film [HD] | 2019
description:
Directed and Editing by: Flavyen Dupont

Assistant Directors : Alexandre Magnin, Alexandre Szynczewski, Anouchka Baridon

Cast: Manuela Rojas Cristancho, Flavyen Dupont, Dimitri Roelants.

This short film is a psychological romance mixing drama and humor. Simon, a young Frenchman living in London for his studies, meets one day Arya, who will question his love relationship. Even today, this young man finds it hard to forget. Faced with a mysterious man, Simon sits in a room explaining his story, his feelings, his doubts.
